method.sampling: three fixed pages per anonymized document: early content, middle content, late content
method.ground_truth: visual transcription from Poppler-rendered source pages before OCR comparison
method.privacy: source files, rendered pages, checkpoint text, filenames, hashes and full results remain in git-ignored local artifacts

decision: Use PaddleOCR as the primary real-scan extraction path. Tesseract remains an auxiliary fallback and must not be the sole source for critical fields without confirmation.
